title: Home practical guide and safety card: circuits
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Working scientifically, revision through enquiry (Revolution)
source: Written for science/y6 lessons 31, 32 (Home practical guide and safety card: circuits (portal worksheet; no mains))
intro: Lesson 31: Circuits and symbols revisited. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To build circuits and change the brightness of a bulb
equipment: A circuit kit: cells in holders, a bulb, wires and a switch
Extra cells and bulbs if you have them
safety: Batteries and kits only: never use mains electricity or sockets
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Build a circuit with one cell, one bulb and a switch
Close the switch and look at the brightness
Add a second cell and look again
Go back to one cell and add a second bulb

questions.q: A circle with a cross is a...
Big question: why might a torch not work?
questions.a: The circuit is incomplete: flat cell, broken bulb, gap or wrong-way cell.
